basis: At the 2010 x-axis checkpoint, the chart explicitly labels the 2010 residential consumption for Coal as 3.27 and for Gas as 5.48. The numerical values are directly readable from the chart. Since 5.48 > 3.27, Gas has the larger 2010 residential consumption level. The task requires routing the resource with the larger 2010 consumption to priority residential supply follow-up. Therefore, Gas should be routed.
option_label: Route 2010 Gas to priority residential supply follow-up
